label: vSRX virtual firewall (SD-WAN edge)
description: Virtual Junos firewall/router instance for branch and SD-WAN edges: up to 10 vNICs, with fxp0 reserved for out-of-band management and ge-0/0/0 upward mapped to traffic vNICs at the hypervisor's NIC speed. There is no physical hardware - port count follows the vNIC set attached to the VM.
notes: vSRX on VMware specification table: "vNICs: Up to 10 vNICs (SR-IOV)"; interface mapping is fxp0 for out-of-band management and ge-0/0/0 for the first traffic vNIC. Cloud variants are smaller (AWS and GCP cap at 8 interfaces, Nutanix 8). Modelled with 10 vNICs at 1G because the link rate is whatever the hypervisor NIC provides, not a fixed optic.
